body:
From your note "make it better": a red Soviet-era village tractor at real size (about 3.9 m long, 2.8 m to the cab roof). Big treaded rear wheels, long hood, grille, round lights, white-roofed glass cab.
Picked in Model Compare.
source: chat 30 Oct: pets and farm audition, round 14
title: Old tractor: redone
